package.name: turtlebot_bringup
package.description: Bringup launch file for the Kobuki-based TurtleBot 2: starts the base driver, cmd_vel multiplexer, safety controller and velocity smoother wired together, mirroring the behaviour of the ROS 1 turtlebot_bringup minimal.launch, plus the robot model and the depth camera / laser scan (3dsensor.launch).
